shown.message:
I checked the system build of `dev` 1b9818d against the venue, and it now meets the requirements. I closed `paper-repo`#5, #6, #8 and #9.

- **Page limit:** the discussion ends on page 9 and References starts on page 10 (27 pages, US Letter), so the main text is within 9 pages. The margin is about one line, so any added text can push it over. I said so in #9.
- **Type 3 fonts:** none on any page. The `courier` fix worked.
- **Build:** `dev` builds again, which closes #6.
- **Floats:** 4 figures and 3 tables in the main text, within my cap.
- **Abstract:** 229 words, inside the 180–230 range.
- **Citations:** the main text cites 27 distinct works, up from 15. The accepted-paper median of 47 is my own planning estimate, not a venue rule. `paper-repo` says the main text has no room for more, and I accepted that. I suggested an extended related-work paragraph in the appendix if they want more coverage.

I haven't checked these on this build: anonymity, whether the style files are unmodified, and whether the checklist is filled. My commitment, issue #3, stays open for the version check.
